note: Provenance for the receipt-witness pack (RECEIPT-WITNESS0, LANE L03, PROGRAM COUNTERPEDIA-FEDERATED-PROOF0). All artifacts in this pack are authored in this repository: synthetic, public-safe ReceiptWitnessObservation fixtures exercising the wire schema and validator at the repo root (schemas/receipt-witness-observation.v0.1.json, tools/receipt_witness.py). They are not copied from any private corpus or external repository, and no real receipt, witness key, or signature is used.

validates_against.note: The wire schema and dataclass/validation module are shared repo-root artifacts (also exercised by scripts/check_receipt_witness.py); this pack does not fork or duplicate them, only adds conformance fixtures and a standalone CLI verifier.

artifacts.role: valid witness observation: node:witness-a observing the fixture receipt digest
valid witness observation: node:witness-b observing the same digest, later
valid witness observation: node:witness-c observing the same digest, later still
forbidden fixture: authority_effect present at all (any presence of an authority-shaped field is rejected, regardless of value -- the structural-absence-invariant probe)
forbidden fixture: witness_node_id below schema minLength
forbidden fixture: extra top-level 'verdict' field (additionalProperties probe)
forbidden fixture: observed_at missing required UTC 'Z' suffix

enforced_by: tools/receipt_witness.py: no authority/admission/trust-shaped field (e.g. authority_effect) is defined anywhere on ReceiptWitnessObservation or the derived witness-set view; REQUIRED_TOP_LEVEL_FIELDS is the closed field set parse_observation accepts, so any attempt to inject such a field into untrusted input is rejected outright (ADDITIONAL_PROPERTIES), regardless of the value it carries
schemas/receipt-witness-observation.v0.1.json: no authority_effect (or similar) property is declared; additionalProperties: false (no verdict/truth/admission/authority field can be added)

packs/receipt-witness/v0.1/tools/verify_witness.py: ObservationVerification carries fixed-False asserts_receipt_validity / asserts_action_authorization / asserts_factual_truth / asserts_admission fields

non_goals: no truth-from-count (witness_count is never a verdict/truth/admission signal)
no mutation of the witnessed receipt
no equivalence with Counterpedia admission authority
